envelope.description: Build fenced session leases and the SQLite upgrade

body.title: Build fenced session leases and the SQLite upgrade
body.summary: Add and test the v3 schema migration and transactional store operations for per-session claims, recovery and completion. Stage the new path behind internal construction until the worker, runtime and view are wired.
acceptanceChecks: Two store connections enforce repository capacity two and one lease per session. Per-chat FIFO and the 10s, 60s, 300s retry schedule remain intact.
Stale ownership tokens cannot mutate or release replacement leases. Finish transitions and releases atomically.
Upgrade preserves messages, order, retries and recoverable CLI identity. Live or unknown legacy ownership defers the upgrade. A failed transaction leaves v2 intact.

tests.name: vscode-plugin/src/chat/__tests__/chat-queue-store.test.ts: two connections enforce session FIFO, two slots and immutable lease fencing
vscode-plugin/src/chat/__tests__/chat-queue-store.test.ts: initial claim preserves attempts and all three retry delays
vscode-plugin/src/chat/__tests__/chat-queue-fault-injection.test.ts: v2 migration preserves records, defers live owners and rolls back atomically
